messages:
Sara Nguyen: Quick FYI, the Next.js + LangChain agent starter we shipped is hitting auth rotation races when running on serverless platforms. Observed double inference attempts and occasional 401s during background key refresh.
Sara Nguyen: Repro steps: deploy starter to Netlify edge, run long-running agent flow (agent calls tools + follow-ups). After ~45s the background key refresher triggers and we see duplicated upstream requests and a dropped response.
Sara Nguyen: Minimal server helper used in starter:
```js
// lib/auth.js
let cached = { key: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, exp: 0 }
export async function getApiKey() {
  if (Date.now() > cached.exp - 30000) {
    const newKey = await fetch(process.env.KEY_ROTATE_URL).then(r => r.text())
    cached = { key: newKey, exp: Date.now() + 15*60*1000 }
  }
  return cached.key
}
```
Liam O'Connor: Probable race: request A starts with key1, background refresh swaps cached.key -> key2 while A is still in-flight; when the transport retries it uses key2 and backend treats it as a new request (no idempotency).
Hana Sato: Do we see transport-level retries or SDK retries? Logs?
Sara Nguyen: Logs: 
[2026-05-04T17:02:11Z] transport: fetch attempt=1 headers.Authorization=Bearer key1
[2026-05-04T17:02:11Z] auth: rotating key -> key2
[2026-05-04T17:02:12Z] transport: fetch retry attempt=2 headers.Authorization=Bearer key2
[2026-05-04T17:02:12Z] sdk: request idempotency=null
Sara Nguyen: So the retry sent a different credential; backend treats it as a distinct invocation and we double-bill and double-execute.
Liam O'Connor: Short-term mitigation: ensure the same key is used for retries. We should snapshot the auth header at request start and keep it constant for retry attempts. Also add idempotency keys for server-side agent calls.
Hana Sato: SDK change idea: add createServerClient({ apiKey, autoRotate: true }) helper that manages rotation but exposes a stable request-signing token per-request and an auto idempotency header. It can also expose getKeyForRequest() so samples don't roll their own naive caches.
Sara Nguyen: I patched the starter in my fork to use a tiny wrapper that pins auth per-request and sets Idempotency-Key: uuidv4(). Verified on Netlify: single request, retry preserved header, no duplicates.
QA Bot: Added CI test: simulate key rotation mid-request; assert outbound_count === 1 for a single logical call. Ticket: starter-templates#412 (P1).
devex-bot: Created issue platform/infra#2334 "SDK: per-request credential pinning + auto-idempotency for server rotations" and assigned to @Liam O'Connor.
Liam O'Connor: I'll open an SDK PR to implement getRequestCredentials() that returns immutable creds for the lifetime of the request and to auto-add Idempotency-Key when called from server contexts. Will add tests for retry+rotation scenarios.
Hana Sato: Docs TODO: quickstart/server-auth.md showing recommended pattern and the new createServerClient wrapper in examples. Also call out ephemeral key rotation caveats for serverless and long-running agent flows.
Sara Nguyen: Thanks — I'll open a PR to replace the naive cache in the starter with the new helper once Liam's PR lands. Leaving the forked patch link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-templates/pull/122 (workaround).
Liam O'Connor: PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/267 (implements per-request credential pinning + auto-idempotency). Requesting review from eng-runtime and security.
Hana Sato: We'll also add an e2e smoke test in the eval harness to assert agent flows don't double-execute under rotation. Good catch, Sara.
Sara Nguyen: Happy to help test on Netlify/Vercel. :thumbsup:
